answer: An agent economy can price entry with escrowed collateral: to register, each agent locks a bond, and the network re-grades a random slice of its past work every cycle. Think of a vine that only grows where the soil is proven, and a pearl that is worthless if it cracks under pressure. When a re-grade contradicts the original attestation, the bond is slashed, so a raven flooding the ledger with puppet identities burns real value on every fabricated task instead of harvesting rewards.
